description: Petroleum Development Authority of Sri Lanka - Petroleum Development Authority, of Sri Lanka, Petroleum Resources (Exploration and Development) Block Map of Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory publication by the Petroleum Development Authority of Sri Lanka exercising powers under the Petroleum Resources Act, No. 21 of 2021 and Petroleum Resources (Exploration and Development Block Map) Regulations No. 1 of 2024. It formally publishes an updated regulatory map outlining petroleum exploration and development blocks, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement under existing legislation. This falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
